notes.title: Get The Puzzle Maker: Cebba's Odyssey for 30% Off!
notes.content:
The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase is live on Steam and you can grab The Puzzle Maker at the lowest price yet! Get 30% off ($8.39) when you buy within the next week. Go pick it up while you still have the chance!

This sale will be active from 5/29 @ 10am PST to 6/5 @ 10am PST.

For years, Cebba has been searching for a worthy mind to inherit her title of Puzzle Maker. She has seen countless others try and fail as they are thwarted by her many trials. Yet, as you stand before her grid of puzzles, she wonders if you may be the one to take her place…

The Puzzle Maker: Cebba’s Odyssey is a strategic puzzle game that dares you to solve over 200 levels of grid-based challenges. Guide your knights, instruct your wizards, and command your pieces in ever more demanding puzzles. One by one, your units must work together to defeat fantastical beasts, conquer obstacles, and solve puzzles.

notes.title: Version 1.04 - bugfixes, localization prep
notes.content:
- Fixed Psyon visual bug that caused a flicker when a tutorial or hint appeared.
- Fixed fade out animation when a unit is standing on a terrain.
- Fixed various journal bugs.
- Fixed tile color not wiping after skipping a puzzle.
- Fixed various typos in clues and hints.
- Fixed bug that caused the game to cut to black on reset when a Gateway is present.
- Fixed puzzle Desert 30.
- Overhauled text system to facilitate localization.

notes.title: Version 1.03 - Various Bugfixes
notes.content:
- Fixed bug that broke the hook shot when moving it onto the gateway.
- Fixed journal entry at the end of the game. 
- Fixed bug that made ogres get caught in their post attack movement after being pushed.

If you have any issues with this patch, please reach out in the discord. (join in main menu)

We are currently working on a weekly puzzle set system where people can design and submit puzzles that can be played by the whole community! Join the discord for future updates.

Happy puzzle solving!

notes.title: THE PUZZLE MAKER: CEBBA'S ODYSSEY OUT NOW
notes.content:
The Puzzle Maker: Cebba’s Odyssey is a cozy, retro-stylish fantasy puzzle game
inspired by the deep strategy of Advance Wars and Into the Breach. Marshal your team
of heroes and spellcasters against monsters and hazards to complete over 200
challenges, calling on their unique skills to create exciting combos in your quest to
become the next Puzzle Maker.

For years, the mysterious Puzzle Maker, Cebba, has sought a worthy successor to her
title. Yet each of her protégés have fallen to her increasingly devious challenges. You
are the last – and most promising – but in your quest to inherit the coveted title of
Puzzle Maker, you’ll need to confront Cebba’s past and unveil her true motivation.

Puzzles take place over a colorful 7-by-7 grid, populated by terrible monsters and
fantastical environmental hazards, from orcs and oozes to strange portals and metallic
fauna, all in a delightfully nostalgic pixel art style. You’ll lead your small band of heroes,
fey creatures, and spellcasters to defeat each enemy and progress to the next of
Cebba’s fiendish puzzles. However, as units can only be moved once per solution –
think single-turn Into the Breach stages – it will take all your cunning to use each
efficiently and complete each challenge.

Play it today!
